title: Todd Monken: Week 1 was tough, our guys trusted the process

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken: Week 1 was tough, our guys trusted the process
sources.description: The Browns moved to 3-1 when Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers's final, desperate heave was picked off by safety Grant Delpit on Thursday night and head coach Todd Monken reflected on how improbable that record would have felt not so long ago.
